capture.backing_behavior: Exports the public wallpaper path currently reported by Noctalia for this output. When W Engine color sync is enabled, this is the representative preview or video frame W Engine already paired; Wall-in-One validates and copies it without reading W Engine's private cache schema.
capture.manual_behavior: Manual pairing validates the selected image and applies it immediately as a standalone static backing; it does not rewrite a playlist entry. To bind a still to video or a Workshop scene, choose Selected still in that entry's editor. Ordinary images keep their durable original path; animated GIFs are decoded to a persistent static PNG, and AVIF validation requires optional ffmpeg.
capture.none: No still has been exported yet.
capture.video_requirement: Configured-video export is deterministic and uses the optional ffmpeg command at the selected frame time. Without ffmpeg, only video and animated-image extraction is unavailable; static pairing and provider controls still work.
capture.w_engine_adapter_boundary: The cooperative W Engine adapter reports the active Workshop ID and owns rendered capture. After successful provider discovery, Wall-in-One sends wall-in-one-probe-v1; the adapter must re-send capabilities and current output state, or stale adapter flags clear after 10 seconds. Each capture request names a unique PNG under Wall-in-One's pluginDataDir()/staging directory, and the adapter must return exactly that requested path. Optional ffmpeg performs decode validation; without it Wall-in-One uses the Workshop source/preview fallback. Wall-in-One never reaches into provider-private state or signals the live renderer directly.
capture.w_engine_adapter_capture: W Engine adapter reports Workshop {id} on {output}; rendered capture is available when optional ffmpeg can decode-validate its PNG, otherwise export uses the source/preview fallback.
capture.w_engine_adapter_status: W Engine adapter reports Workshop {id} on {output}; capture is not advertised, so export uses the safe source/preview fallback.
capture.w_engine_fallback_boundary: Without a cooperative capture adapter, Wall-in-One does not claim to capture the live frame. It exports a real frame from Workshop video projects or copies the Workshop preview for scene/web projects.
capture.w_engine_internal_boundary: Internal capture sequentially replaces only Wall-in-One's exact owned Wallpaper Engine child, asks linux-wallpaperengine for its rendered FBO, validates the private staging PNG, and installs it atomically. No foreign renderer is inspected or signalled.
capture.w_engine_internal_capture: Wall-in-One owns Workshop {id} on {output}; native rendered still capture is available.
capture.w_engine_unavailable: No internally active, adapter-reported, or configured numeric Workshop ID is available. Configure an ID, select a static backing, or use configured-video export.

use_mpvpaper.label: Enable mpvpaper integration

use_motionbgs.description: Enable the unofficial bounded MotionBGS public-page adapter. Turning it off does not remove the permanent direct-site fallback.
use_motionbgs.label: Use MotionBGS public-page adapter

use_w_engine.description: Gate both cooperative W Engine integration and Wall-in-One's internally owned linux-wallpaperengine backend, controls, and Workshop capture paths. Turning this off never stops or disables a foreign provider process.
use_w_engine.label: Enable Wallpaper Engine integration

use_wallhaven.description: Enable Wall-in-One's native official-API search, detail, and managed download service. Turning this off does not disable or uninstall the separate official Noctalia Wallhaven plugin.
use_wallhaven.label: Use native Wallhaven integration

wallhaven_api_key.description: Optional Wallhaven API key sent only in the X-API-Key request header. Public SFW search works without it; Wallhaven requires authentication for NSFW results. This value is stored as a normal Noctalia plugin setting, not an encrypted secret.
wallhaven_api_key.label: Wallhaven API key

video_directory.description: Root for user-owned video wallpapers. Wall-in-One-managed MotionBGS downloads use a separate cache subfolder when the adapter is usable. This may be the same folder as the image wallpaper directory; files are sorted by media type.
video_directory.label: Video wallpaper directory

video_frame_second.description: Timestamp, in seconds, used for configured videos and Workshop video projects.
video_frame_second.label: Video still timestamp

video_source.description: Video or animated-image file used by deterministic Export configured video actions. The optional ffmpeg command is required only for video or animated-image extraction.
video_source.label: Configured video source

workshop_directory.description: Optional additional Wallpaper Engine Workshop content/431960 directory.
workshop_directory.label: Additional Workshop directory

workshop_id.description: Numeric Wallpaper Engine Workshop item used when no cooperative W Engine status adapter reports the active item. Video projects export a frame; scene/web projects use their preview.
workshop_id.label: Workshop ID fallback

w_engine_backend.description: Auto keeps the detected W Engine plugin as owner. Internal enables apply-by-ID and mixed cycling only when that external plugin is disabled.
w_engine_backend.label: Wallpaper Engine backend

w_engine_clamp.description: Texture edge behavior for Wall-in-One's internally owned linux-wallpaperengine renderer.
w_engine_clamp.label: Wallpaper Engine edge mode

w_engine_disable_mouse.description: Disable mouse input in internally owned Wallpaper Engine scenes.
w_engine_disable_mouse.label: Disable scene mouse input

w_engine_disable_parallax.description: Disable parallax in internally owned Wallpaper Engine scenes.
w_engine_disable_parallax.label: Disable scene parallax

w_engine_disable_particles.description: Disable particles in internally owned Wallpaper Engine scenes.
w_engine_disable_particles.label: Disable scene particles

w_engine_fps.description: Frame-rate limit for internally owned Wallpaper Engine scenes.
w_engine_fps.label: Wallpaper Engine FPS

w_engine_fullscreen_pause_only_active.description: Pause only for the active fullscreen window. Do not enable together with Never pause for fullscreen.
w_engine_fullscreen_pause_only_active.label: Pause only for active fullscreen

w_engine_no_audio_processing.description: Disable Wallpaper Engine audio processing for internally owned scenes.
w_engine_no_audio_processing.label: Disable scene audio processing

w_engine_no_fullscreen_pause.description: Never pause the internal Wallpaper Engine renderer for fullscreen windows. Do not enable together with active-fullscreen-only pause.
w_engine_no_fullscreen_pause.label: Never pause for fullscreen

w_engine_scaling.description: Scaling used by Wall-in-One's internally owned linux-wallpaperengine renderer.
w_engine_scaling.label: Wallpaper Engine scaling

w_engine_silent.description: Launch internally owned Wallpaper Engine scenes without audio. When off, the configured volume is used.
w_engine_silent.label: Silent Wallpaper Engine

w_engine_volume.description: Audio volume for internally owned Wallpaper Engine scenes when silent mode is off.
w_engine_volume.label: Wallpaper Engine volume

widget.storage_error: Wall-in-One storage is invalid. Open its panel through Noctalia IPC to view Diagnostics.
